name: Emoji Reactions
description: Fieldable per-entity emoji reaction system with AJAX toggling, user analytics, a reaction log, 23 display layouts, a REST API and Views integration.
project_description: Emoji Reactions adds a fully-featured, per-entity emoji reaction system to any Drupal 10 or 11 site. It ships an emoji_reaction field type that attaches to any fieldable entity through the standard Manage Fields UI; editors and visitors then toggle reactions with a single click and counts update live over AJAX. It provides six default emoji config entities (thumbs up, heart, celebrate, sad, wow, angry), each of which may be a Unicode character, an image URL or raw SVG markup, with drag-and-drop ordering, per-emoji enable/disable and accessibility labels. Display is configured per view-mode on the field formatter (23 layouts including social-media-inspired styles) or via an Emoji Reactions block. Every reaction event is recorded in a reaction log with timestamp, user, entity, emoji, browser, OS, device type, masked IP and language, exposed through a filterable admin log, per-entity and site-wide statistics reports, and Views integration. A REST API (submit/toggle and read-data endpoints) supports decoupled front-ends, and a hook system (react_alter, display_alter, access, log_fields, log_insert, count_alter) allows custom integrations. Anonymous reactions are supported and deduplicated via HMAC-hashed IP and/or session identifiers, with a configurable expiry window, and Drupal's flood API throttles reaction abuse.
